units.intent: Header-only template that spins up a multi-node bedrock cluster (each node a BedrockTester subprocess), waits for every node to answer Status, and tears the cluster down leader-last so tests can exercise replication/consensus.

objects.name: ClusterTester<T>
objects.role: builds/starts/stops a cluster of T (typically BedrockTester) instances with generated ports and peer lists

misfits.item: ClusterTester<T>'s sized constructor: testplugin.so auto-detection block
misfits.why: plugin-specific special-casing (checking cwd for testplugin/testplugin.so) inside an otherwise generic cluster-bootstrap helper; the code's own comment says it 'should get moved somewhere else, really. Probably inside TestPlugin.'
misfits.suggested_home: TestPlugin or a test-fixture setup helper, per the code's own TODO comment

location_fit.note: cluster test scaffolding belongs in test/clustertest.

naming_quality.note: the sized constructor's `_args` parameter uses the repo's private-member `_` prefix on a plain constructor parameter, not a member.

units.intent: Entry point for the cluster/replication test binary: parses the same family of CLI flags as test/main.cpp and drives tpunit::Tests::run, deliberately not resetting state between tests.

objects.name: sigclean
objects.role: SIGINT handler that stops any running test servers before exiting

objects.name: log
objects.role: execs `tail -f /var/log/syslog | grep bedrock` into log.txt; not called anywhere in this file

objects.name: main
objects.role: parses args and runs the test suite (optionally repeated)

misfits.why: dead code - defined but never invoked from main; also a generic name that collides in intent with the repo's SINFO/SWARN logging macros despite doing something unrelated (execing into tail+grep)

name_fit.note: a plain main.cpp test-binary entry point.

naming_quality.note: `log` as a free-function name is generic and easily confused with actual logging.
